footer.tagline: Lexora: your business's own private language. A constructed language is a communication tool, not encryption.
hero.eyebrow: A private language for your business
hero.title: Invent a language your team actually owns.
hero.lead: Lexora turns your company's own word list (with Bengali and English references kept side by side) into a complete constructed language: sounds, words, grammar and example sentences you can review and revise.
how.title: How it works
how.step1_body: Add words one by one or import a CSV. Every word keeps its বাংলা and English meaning as reference.
how.step2_body: Lexora designs a sound system, maps every concept to a new word, and writes grammar rules, explained in English and Bengali.
how.step3_body: Draft translations, coin new words consistently, and practice until the language feels natural.
review.title: You review everything
review.body: Generated words arrive as drafts, translations are marked draft, and every grammar rule explains itself. Nothing is presented as more than it is.
private.title: Private to your workspace
private.body: Each workspace has its own dictionary and language, isolated on the server. Members see only what their role allows: viewer, editor, admin, owner.
features.title: Everything a private language needs
features.dictionary_body: Bilingual references, pronunciation guides, roots and mnemonics. Search, filter, import and export (CSV/JSON).
features.generation_body: Phonology, vocabulary mapping, grammar rules and example sentences, generated stage by stage, versioned and reversible.
features.translation_body: Rule-based drafts built from your own dictionary, with word-by-word mapping. Honest about what it can't translate.
features.wordbuilder_body: Coin new words that follow your language's sound rules and derivation patterns, with collision checks.
features.practice_body: Spaced repetition so the team actually remembers the words. You answer, it schedules. No shortcuts.
features.roles_body: Owner, admin, editor, viewer. Every import, export and generation is logged in your workspace's activity log.
security.title: Private by design, and honest about limits
security.lead: What Lexora protects, how, and what it explicitly does not do.
security.isolation_title: Workspace isolation, enforced on every call
security.isolation_body: Every read, write, search, export and generation is checked against your membership before it runs: a workspace you don't belong to answers "not found", so it can't even be probed for existence. Lexora runs without a server of its own — the checks execute in the app's data layer with your own signed-in token, and we document the limits of that model plainly instead of overstating them.
security.sso_body: There is no Lexora password. You sign in through your organisation's SELISE Blocks SSO, and every data call carries your own signed-in identity — Lexora never sees or stores a password, and it keeps no session cookies of its own.
security.audit_body: Imports, exports, generations and cancellations, renames, membership changes and deletions are recorded in your workspace's activity log — and the log outlives the workspace itself.
security.not_title: What a constructed language is not
security.not_strong: A constructed language is not encryption.
security.not_body: Anyone who learns it can read it. Use Lexora to build identity, culture and a fun private register, never to protect secrets, credentials or personal data.
